newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU extends wheat export tender to ACP to Oct 31.
newsitem.headline: EU extends wheat export tender to ACP to Oct 31.

text.p: The European Union has extended until October 31 a tender for the export of EU free-market soft wheat to African, Caribbean and Pacific nations, France's grain office ONIC said on Friday.
The EU's grain panel in Brussels took the decision on Thursday while adding 200,000 tonnes to its quota of free-market soft wheat available for export to these countries.
This brings to 400,000 tonnes the soft wheat total set aside by the EU for export to ACP countries since July 4. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
